duals_note: Shadow prices and demand prices are row duals of the LP with the binaries fixed at the MILP optimum: they are conditional on that open set and valid only for small right-hand-side changes. Absent for relaxed scenarios.
flow_precision: tons rounded to 3 decimals; flows below 0.0005 t omitted
journeys_note: journeys = [plant, site, node, commodity, tons]: outbound tons of commodity k from site f are attributed to plants in proportion to f's inbound tons of k (computed from the 3-decimal route lists, rows below 0.0005 t omitted). hero = the largest packaged-goods journey with both legs >= 100 road-equivalent miles (ties: lowest plant, site, node). Tons are rounded per row, so row sums match routes within 0.01 t per (site, node, commodity).
